references.text: Describes the same border area at Ataroth-Addar near Lower Beth-horon, which is part of the same geographical region mentioned in Joshua's boundary descriptions.
Mentions Ataroth as part of Ephraim's southern border, the same city referred to in verse 7 as part of the eastern border.
Describes Benjamin's border going down toward the Jordan, the same river that marks the eastern border of Ephraim's territory.
Jericho is mentioned as an important city in the Jordan Valley, the same area where Ephraim's border meets the Jordan.
Mentions Ataroth as one of the cities in the region east of the Jordan, related to the geographical locations in Ephraim's boundary description.
